meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会持续盯住一个 Pull Request（PR）：反复查看评论、审核意见和自动检查结果，发现真问题就修改代码并推送，直到所有问题解决、检查通过、可以合并为止。期间会给出最新提交、检查结果和剩余未解决问题等具体证据。
howto.when: 当用户要求它“盯着”某个 PR、持续监控审核和检查，或反复检查评论直到所有问题解决时触发。

say.text: 帮我盯着这个 PR，直到能合并。
say.note: Claude 会开始监视该 PR 的检查与评论。

say.text: 持续检查这个 pull request 的评论和 CI，有问题就修。
say.note: 发现问题会修复并推送新提交。

say.text: 监控未解决的 review 线程，处理完再报告。
say.note: 会验证代码后解决过时线程。

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude watches a PR until mergeable: re-checks comments/reviews/CI, fixes issues by pushing commits, then reports latest commit, check status, and unresolved items.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to babysit, monitor, or keep checking a PR's comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Watch this PR for me until it can be merged.
say_en.note: Claude will monitor checks and comments.

say_en.text: Keep checking this pull request's comments and CI; fix any issue found.
Monitor unresolved review threads and tell me when done.
